statement: Orient vector and symbol fill patterns by linking them to the project origin or to a fill origin with a draggable handle, plus distortion modes for special cases.

source.ref: Set Orientation of Vector or Symbol Fill Patterns

superiority: Pattern anchoring is a visible handle on the element.
notes: CORRECTED — read Set Orientation of Vector or Symbol Fill Patterns; methods include Link to Project Origin, Link to Fill Origin, 3D and custom distortion, radial distortion for symbol fills; no pick-a-point option separate from the fill handle. Acceptance sketch: Moving the fill origin shifts the pattern by the same vector and the outline stays put.

statement: Draw natural splines and Bezier splines, and shape the latter with per-node tangent handles whose lengths differ per side but share one angle.
superiority: Exact curve export as NURBS to CAD formats.
notes: CORRECTED — read Drawing Splines; 'fit points' as a separate concept is not named (natural splines use nodes); tangent continuity comes from one angle per node. Overlaps CAD2D-0014, which now covers node editing. Acceptance sketch: Edit a handle and verify G1 continuity at the node within 1e-6 rad.

statement: Edit polylines and arcs through the pet palette (curving a segment, adjusting an arc by its tangent), unify connected lines and arcs into one polyline, or open a closed polyline by deleting a segment.
superiority: Same exact arcs in all outputs.
notes: CORRECTED — read Editing Polylines and Editing an Arc Using its Tangent; unify via Edit > Reshape > Unify; Ctrl-click deletes a segment; dashed pattern can run per segment or over the whole polyline. Acceptance sketch: Convert a segment to an arc tangent to its neighbour and verify tangency to 1e-9.

statement: Format text blocks per character and paragraph with fonts, alignment, leading, symbols, autotext and indent or tab controls in a text editor with a formatting palette, allowing several styles in one block.

source.ref: Formatting Palette and Text Editor Controls

superiority: Unicode shaping for all scripts including right to left.
notes: CORRECTED — read Formatting Palette and Text Editor Controls and Formatting Individual Components of Text Blocks; list formatting was not seen in the cached text, indent/tab controls are mentioned. Acceptance sketch: A tab stop aligns two text columns at the stated position.

statement: Search and replace text across text blocks, labels, dimensions, zone stamps and object parameters in 2D windows, and spell-check the project using the platform's word-processor dictionaries.
superiority: Language-aware checking with custom dictionaries.
notes: CORRECTED — read Search and Replace Text and Spell Checker; autotext is excluded; works in plan, section and detail windows (not 'all views'); spell check uses Microsoft Word on Windows and system settings on Mac. Acceptance sketch: Replace count equals occurrences in the project.

statement: Provide level dimensions that show a story level or an element's elevation measured from a chosen reference level, attached to slabs, meshes, roofs, shells and stairs.
superiority: Linked to project reference levels so they update with them.
notes: CORRECTED — read Level Dimension Tool Settings and Level Dimensions; marker type, size and pen are set in the type panel; reference levels come from Project Preferences; level dimensions are for plan and detail windows. Acceptance sketch: The reading equals element elevation minus the reference level.

statement: Place associative dimension chains on selected walls or curtain walls automatically for overall length, external geometry, structure thickness and openings measured at centre or edges.
superiority: Rules selectable per drafting standard.
notes: CORRECTED — read Automatic Exterior Dimensioning; four dimension line types; grids and a tolerance setting were not found in the cached page; interior dimensioning is separate (see CAD2D-0016). Acceptance sketch: Chain includes all openings and the overall dimension equals the sum of parts.

statement: Assign cover fills to beams, columns, slabs, meshes, roofs, shells, openings, morphs and zones so a surface hatch appears in plan apart from the cut fill, with pen, background and orientation controls.
superiority: Same fills in all views.
notes: CORRECTED — read Assign a Cover Fill; this is surface-hatch display on elements, not a finish-layer overlay; cover fills must be defined as such in the Fills attribute; 'Use Fill from Surface' option exists. Acceptance sketch: A cover fill draws beneath the outline and above the cut fill.

statement: Mark changes with clouds and/or markers from a change tool, linked to named Changes in a manager so layout revisions detect them automatically.
superiority: Automatic detection of changed items between versions.
notes: CORRECTED — read Working with Changes, Change Manager Palette and Create Change; Change tool places markers in plan, section, detail and layout windows; linking to elements or markers enables automatic detection; unlinked markers are purely graphical. Acceptance sketch: A cloud encloses changed items of the revision and links to its entry.

statement: Overlay a reference view or drawing on the active one with separate display colours, transparent fills and swappable display order to see differences on screen.
superiority: Semantic diff of model elements, not only linework.
notes: CORRECTED — read Compare Reference with Active; on-screen only with no output effect; controlled in the Trace & Reference palette. Acceptance sketch: Differences between two versions are highlighted and counted.

statement: Print or plot in colour, grayscale or forced black and white, where output colour is also set per placed drawing.
superiority: Output profile stored with the publisher set.
notes: CORRECTED — read Print and Print 2D Document dialog (Black and White box, grayscale); pen sets are applied in model views, a pen-mapping table specific to print was not confirmed. Acceptance sketch: Grey scale conversion maps pens to luminance values.

statement: Create detail and worksheet windows from model content as 2D lines and fills, or as independent viewpoints, and edit them with drafting tools, where worksheets keep annotations and source scale.
superiority: Worksheets are native, versioned drawing documents.
notes: CORRECTED — read Worksheet vs. Detail, Contents of the Worksheet Window and Create a Worksheet Drawing with Model Source; worksheet captures whole window with one click; detail defaults to half scale and omits annotations. Acceptance sketch: A worksheet detail contains the drawn primitives and prints at scale.

statement: Merge a DWG or DXF file's model space into the current view or append its paper spaces to the layout book, with the translation setup controlling how layers and blocks are converted.
superiority: Reusable mapping presets.
notes: CORRECTED — read Merge DXF-DWG and Layers (DXF/DWG Translation Setup); layer conversion uses a name conversion dictionary and custom names rather than a merge-time mapping table (save-side methods were read). Acceptance sketch: The mapping applies and the layer counts match the table.

statement: Insert, move or delete spline nodes, offset a spline, and unify a chain of connected splines through pet palette commands.
superiority: Exact curve export as NURBS to CAD formats.
notes: CORRECTED — read Editing Splines; duplicate of CAD2D-0002 as originally written, now narrowed to node editing, offset and unify; Bezier handle editing is in Drawing Splines. Acceptance sketch: Edit a handle and verify G1 continuity at the node within 1e-6 rad.

statement: Provide elevation dimensions in section, elevation and 3D document windows whose origin can be project zero, sea level or a reference level.
superiority: Linked to project reference levels.
notes: CORRECTED — read Elevation Dimensions; duplicate of CAD2D-0006 as written; elevation dimensions are the section/3D-document counterpart of level dimensions and can dimension all story level lines at once. Acceptance sketch: Level equals element elevation minus reference.

statement: Dimension selected columns and composite or profile elements automatically along a drawn line, choosing centre or ends of columns, all skins or total thickness, and outer faces, core faces or reference lines.
superiority: Keep interior dimension chains associative and re-routed automatically when walls move, with live preview before placement.
notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Automatic Interior Dimensioning; profiled columns are ignored; walls, columns, beams and slab/roof/mesh edges crossing the drawn line are dimensioned. Acceptance sketch: Three columns crossed by a line, centre option: one chain with 3 points at column axes; end option: points at both column faces.

statement: Place labels associated with an element that follow it, in text/autotext or symbol form, choosing the element by hover and Tab among overlapping ones.
superiority: Let labels carry arbitrary computed properties and re-attach automatically after element replacement.
notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Place an Associative Label; related pages cover text/autotext labels, symbol labels with element information and labeling multiple selected elements. Acceptance sketch: Label bound to a wall displaying its thickness: after changing thickness 200 to 300 the label text updates to 300 without manual edit.

statement: Insert autotext tokens in text and labels that fill from project, site, building or element data and refresh when the model, layout or drawing changes.
superiority: Support user-defined expression tokens evaluated live with unit-aware formatting.
notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Autotext and Autotext Keywords; keyword tags such as <PROJECTNAME> exist for GDL scripts; also usable in publisher names and markers. Acceptance sketch: Autotext for project name in a title: after renaming the project in project info, the placed text shows the new name.

statement: Keep a project keynote database of identifier, title, description and reference in a hierarchical palette, place keynote labels from it, and build a legend on the layout.
superiority: Link keynotes to specification sections with revision tracking and one-click conflict resolution across linked files.
notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Keynotes and Place Keynote Labels; supports import/export, search, hotlinked keynotes with conflict marking and Teamwork. Acceptance sketch: Edit keynote title in the palette: all placed keynote labels update; legend lists only keynotes visible on the placed drawings when that option is on.

statement: Apply linear or radial gradient fills to 2D drafting fills using the foreground and background pen colours, adjustable by a fill handle.
superiority: Allow gradients on cover and cut fills as well, with exact vector output for printing.
notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Using Gradient Fills; drafting fills only, not available as cut or cover fills; handle visibility requires Fill Handles in On-Screen View Options. Acceptance sketch: Fill with foreground red and background blue, linear: first transition boundary and angle follow handle positions and the colours at the extremes equal the pens.

statement: Group layouts into transmittal sets that record which Changes were issued in each layout revision, with only one set open at a time.
superiority: Build the issue register automatically from changes and publish a transmittal list alongside the PDF set.
notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Managing Transmittal Sets and Add/Remove Changes on Layout Revisions; transmitted changes cannot be deleted, only archived; changes can be added to or removed from open layout revisions. Acceptance sketch: Create a transmittal set while two layouts have untransmitted revisions: both are added; a second set cannot be created until the first is closed.
